_comment: The most of each guide that may be a stand-in rather than a programme,
as a share of its rows. A stand-in is a title that fills time instead of
describing a broadcast: 'لا توجد مباراة مجدولة', the tabii PPV notice,
a channel repeating its own name, an operator's blurb about itself.
This exists because ON Sport spent days at 94% stand-in — its source,
FilGoal's RSS, had been shut off and every run said so in a warning
nobody read. The guide kept publishing, kept passing every check, and
the only thing that noticed was a person looking at a television.
Each ceiling is set a little above what that guide measured while it
was known to be working, so ordinary variation passes and a source
going dark does not. Raising one is a decision to be made deliberately,
with the measurement that justifies it — not a way to quiet a red run.
onsport_note: 70 rather than today's 94: the guide is blind at 94 and this change is what fixes it. If it comes back above 70 the front page has gone the way of the RSS.
working_note: Alwan, Fajer and Thmanyah are confirmed working by their owner at these levels; their ceilings sit just above where they measured, not at some ideal.
